description: Remove a background color from an image and make it transparent. Outputs a PNG with alpha channel. The image must already exist in /tmp/churn-udbd3sfk/Pictures/pixel-surgeon (use save_image to import first).

color.description: Target background color as hex (e.g. "#FFFFFF" for white, "#000000" for black, "#FF0000" for red). Default: white.

filename.description: Filename of the source image in /tmp/churn-udbd3sfk/Pictures/pixel-surgeon

threshold.description: How far from the target color a pixel can be and still count as background (0 = exact match only, 30 = default, higher = more aggressive)

name: remove_background
